programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: Professors Jay and Rhonda are interested in historic preservation and look for an old home of their own; Erin and Ben revive a 1920s Craftsman cottage that stays true to its character, including original woodwork.

programs.title: Christina On The Coast
programs.desc: When Christina takes on the redesign of a 1950s midcentury home, she helps a family preserve their history while turning a dark, closed-off kitchen into an open and bright entertaining space that will create new memories for years to come.

programs.title: Postcards
programs.desc: Sammy J shows us the art and culture in Mildura. Shane explores a range of cuisines on offer in St Kilda. Madeline is in QLD at a paddock to plate pub. And Brodie checks out an incredible eco-friendly accommodation in the Yarra Valley.

programs.title: Getaway
programs.desc: This week on Getaway we are in Greece visiting some of the most historic sites of all time including the ancient neighbourhoods of Athens, the sacred precinct of Delphi plus the remains of Olympia.

programs.title: Building Roots
programs.desc: Two siblings love their Colorado legacy home, but the structure and decor is the same as when it was purchased 35 years ago. Now, Ben and Cristi transform the property into a mountain lodge suited for their large family gatherings.

programs.title: Masters Of Flip
programs.desc: Dave Wilson makes a compelling case for adjusting the budget, while ensuring the foundations are up to his standards. Partner Kortney encourages her design team to colour outside of the lines.
